series.name: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)
series.notes: US single-phase hybrid PCS (GROWATT ARO battery + SM-US-200 meter). Manual splits §11.4.2 System fault, §11.4.3 Inverter warning, §11.4.4 Inverter fault, plus §7.3.2 LED table with POWER/COMM/BAT/FAULT. This body drops several codes the TL3 string manuals carry (no 200/300 AFCI rows, no 402-equivalent naming difference) - do not backfill. Codes here are the US-grid variants; wording differs from EU bodies (e.g. Error 303 is 'PE abnormal' here, 'NE abnormal' on TL3-X).

title.en: Residual I high (leakage current too high)
title.ur: Residual I high (leakage current bohat zyada)

meaning.en: Residual current has gone above the limit, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Residual current limit se upar chala gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Insulation breakdown in the PV array or cabling
causes.ur: PV array ya cabling mein insulation breakdown

causes.en: Water in a junction box or DC isolator
causes.ur: Junction box ya DC isolator mein paani

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure array insulation resistance to earth with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke megohmmeter se array ki earth ke taraf insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV strings one by one to find the leaking one.
solutions.ur: PV strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karke leaking string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the error message still exists, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; error message phir bhi rahe to Growatt se rabta karein.

meaning.en: DC input voltage is above the maximum tolerable value for this unit.
meaning.ur: DC input voltage is unit ke maximum tolerable value se upar hai.

causes.en: String Voc too high in cold ambient conditions
causes.ur: Thande mausam mein string ka Voc bohat zyada

causes.en: String voltage rise from a partial disconnect on one string
causes.ur: Kisi string ka partial disconnect hone se voltage barh gaya

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check the voltage of each PV string with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har PV string ka voltage check karein.

solutions.en: If the PV string voltage is lower than 550 V, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Agar PV string voltage 550 V se kam hai to Growatt se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and ground has fallen below the threshold; this manual gives explicit impedance limits.
meaning.ur: PV array aur ground ke darmiyan insulation threshold se neeche gir gaya; is manual mein impedance limits diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Panel enclosure not grounded properly, or inverter ground not solid
causes.ur: Panel enclosure theek se grounded nahi, ya inverter ground mazboot nahi

causes.en: DC breaker has got wet, or cable insulation is damaged
causes.ur: DC breaker geela ho gaya, ya cable insulation damaged hai

solutions.en: Check if the panel enclosure is grounded properly, then check that the inverter ground is solid.
solutions.ur: Pehle panel enclosure theek grounded hai ya nahi check karein, phir inverter ground mazboot hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check if the DC breaker has got wet and inspect it for water ingress.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke DC breaker geela to nahi ho gaya aur usmein paani ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure PV(+) to PV(-) to ground impedance - the manual requires more than 25 kOhm (550 kOhm per VDE 0126).
solutions.ur: PV(+) se PV(-) aur ground ke darmiyan impedance measure karein - manual ke mutabiq 25 kOhm se zyada (VDE 0126 ke mutabiq 550 kOhm) hona chahiye.

title.en: AC V outrange (utility grid voltage out of range)
title.ur: AC V outrange (grid voltage range se bahar)

meaning.en: Utility grid voltage is outside the permissible range, so grid connection is blocked.
meaning.ur: Utility grid voltage permissible range se bahar hai, is liye grid connection block hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage out of the local standard window
causes.ur: Grid voltage local standard window se bahar hai

causes.en: Neutral or ground wire loose in the AC wiring
causes.ur: AC wiring mein neutral ya ground wire loose hai

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch first.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch band karein.

solutions.en: Check AC wiring, especially neutral and the ground wire, and re-torque the terminals.
solutions.ur: AC wiring check karein, khaas kar neutral aur ground wire, aur terminals dobara torque karein.

solutions.en: Check grid voltage against the local grid standard, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage ko local grid standard se check karke inverter restart karein.

title.ur: PE abnormal (N aur PE ka voltage 30 V se upar)

meaning.en: Voltage between neutral and PE is above 30 V, so the inverter has shut down.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur PE ke darmiyan voltage 30 V se upar hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: PE conductor open, so neutral floats through the load
causes.ur: PE conductor khul gaya hai, is liye neutral load ke zariye float kar raha hai

causes.en: Neutral and PE swapped at the AC terminal
causes.ur: AC terminal par neutral aur PE swap ho gaye hain

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch, then check AC wiring, especially neutral and ground wire.
solutions.ur: DC switch band karke AC wiring check karein, khaas kar neutral aur ground wire.

solutions.en: Measure the voltage of neutral to PE; anything above 30 V is a fault condition.
solutions.ur: Neutral se PE voltage measure karein; 30 V se upar koi bhi reading fault condition hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the error message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; error message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The inverter's pre-connection auto test did not pass, so it will not connect.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka connection se pehle ka auto test pass nahi hua, is liye woh connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid conditions not settled when the test ran
causes.ur: Test chalne ke waqt grid conditions settle nahi hue

causes.en: PV insulation or AFCI self-test failing the same test
causes.ur: PV insulation ya AFCI self-test bhi isi test mein fail ho raha hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and repeat the auto test.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke auto test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Check PV isolation and PE continuity before repeating, so a real earth fault is not mistaken for a test failure.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalane se pehle PV isolation aur PE continuity check karein taake asal earth fault ko test failure na samajhein.

solutions.en: If the problem still exists, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Agar masla phir bhi hai to Growatt se rabta karein.

title.ur: DSP ka M3 se communication abnormal hai

meaning.en: The DSP on the control board and the M3 communication board are not exchanging data.
meaning.ur: Control board ka DSP aur M3 communication board aapas mein data exchange nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: DSP and M3 firmware versions do not match
causes.ur: DSP aur M3 firmware versions match nahi karte

causes.en: Communication ribbon cable or connector loose
causes.ur: Communication ribbon cable ya connector loose

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the DSP-to-M3 ribbon connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke DSP se M3 ribbon connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Update the DSP and M3 firmware to a matched pair.
solutions.ur: DSP aur M3 firmware ko matched pair par update karein.

solutions.en: Change the DSP board or M3 board if the problem persists, then claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar masla bacha rahe to DSP board ya M3 board badlein, phir Growatt warranty claim karein.

meaning.en: Settings memory cannot be read or written.
meaning.ur: Settings memory parh ya likh nahi sakta.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or its solder joint on the M3 board
causes.ur: M3 board par EEPROM chip ya uska solder joint

causes.en: Power loss during a settings write
causes.ur: Settings write ke dauran power chala jana

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, wait 5 minutes, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein, phir inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Note whether the error appears only in the morning - a marginal chip behaves that way.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke error sirf subah aata hai ya nahi - marginal chip aise hi behave karta hai.

solutions.en: If the fault is sustained, the M3 board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar fault barqarar rahe to M3 board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

aliases: DSP and redundant M3 data mismatch

title.en: DSP and redundant M3 sampled data not the same
title.ur: DSP aur redundant M3 ka data same nahi hai

meaning.en: The DSP and the redundant M3 board are sampling the same signals and getting different answers.
meaning.ur: DSP aur redundant M3 board wahi signals sample karke alag jawab de rahe hain.

causes.en: One sampling channel has drifted
causes.ur: Kisi aik sampling channel bekar chala hai

causes.en: Redundant wiring harness between DSP and M3 has a poor connection
causes.ur: DSP aur M3 ke darmiyan redundant wiring harness ka connection kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the redundancy harness connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke redundancy harness connectors dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and check whether the code is consistent or intermittent.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke check karein ke code consistent hai ya intermittent.

solutions.en: If the channels never agree, the M3 board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar channels kabhi match na hon to M3 board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

meaning.en: The ground fault circuit interrupter has reported a fault condition.
meaning.ur: Ground fault circuit interrupter ne fault condition report kiya.

causes.en: GFCI module damaged by a surge or repeated leakage trips
causes.ur: Surge ya baar baar leakage trips se GFCI module kharab

causes.en: Real earth fault still present in the array
causes.ur: Array mein asal earth fault abhi bhi mojood hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure the array insulation resistance to rule out a real earth fault.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke asal earth fault rule out karne ke liye array ki insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see whether the code clears.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke dekhein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the code returns with good insulation, the power board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar insulation theek hone par bhi code wapas aaye to power board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

title.en: FAULT LED solid red - arc fault
title.ur: FAULT LED lal bar lal - arc fault

meaning.en: Solid red FAULT LED with the buzzer sounding means an arc fault is present.
meaning.ur: Solid red FAULT LED aur buzzer bolna matlab arc fault mojood hai.

causes.en: Real arc at a PV connector, module or DC cable
causes.ur: PV connector, module ya DC cable par asal arc

causes.en: A tripped AFCI that has not been reset
causes.ur: AFCI trip ho gaya aur reset nahi hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then inspect every DC connector for heat damage.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke har DC connector par garmi ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Press the internal arc reset button for 3-5 seconds to clear the arc fault.
solutions.ur: Arc fault clear karne ke liye andar wale arc reset button ko 3-5 second tak dabayein.

solutions.en: After shutdown, check the panel terminal wiring before restarting.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle shutdown ke baad panel terminal wiring check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED red steady on + buzzer sounding

title.en: FAULT LED blinking 1s on/1s off - warning
title.ur: FAULT LED 1s on/1s off blink - warning

meaning.en: A blinking red FAULT LED means a warning condition - the inverter usually derates rather than stops.
meaning.ur: Blinking red FAULT LED ka matlab warning condition hai - inverter aam tor par band hone ke bajaye power kam karta hai.

causes.en: Any of the §11.4.3 warning codes, e.g. meter abnormal or EEPROM abnormal
causes.ur: §11.4.3 ke kisi bhi warning code ka haal, jaise meter abnormal ya EEPROM abnormal

causes.en: WiFi / 4G communication loss reported elsewhere
causes.ur: WiFi / 4G communication loss kisi aur jagah report hua

solutions.en: Read the exact warning on the LED screen or the ShinePhone app before acting.
solutions.ur: Koi kaam karne se pehle LED screen ya ShinePhone app par exact warning padhein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once; most warnings clear on restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karein; zyada tar warnings restart par clear ho jate hain.

solutions.en: If the same warning keeps returning, note it and follow that code's own procedure.
solutions.ur: Agar wahi warning baar baar aata rahe to use note karein aur usi code ka procedure follow karein.

title.en: BAT LED fast blink - battery in fault mode
title.ur: BAT LED tez blink - battery fault mode mein hai

meaning.en: The battery side has latched a fault; the inverter may be running on PV or grid only.
meaning.ur: Battery side ne fault latch kar liya hai; inverter sirf PV ya grid par chal raha ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Battery BMS has latched a fault such as over/under voltage or over-temperature
causes.ur: Battery BMS ne over/under voltage ya over-temperature jaisa fault latch kar liya hai

causes.en: Battery communication to the inverter has dropped
causes.ur: Battery ka inverter se communication gir gaya hai

solutions.en: Check battery terminal voltage with a multimeter before touching connections.
solutions.ur: Connections chhoone se pehle multimeter se battery terminal voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the battery (many ARO-type packs have a reset button) and confirm it wakes up.
solutions.ur: Battery ko power-cycle karein (bohat se ARO packs mein reset button hota hai) aur confirm karein ke woh jaag jati hai.

solutions.en: If the battery still faults, read the BMS's own fault code before replacing anything.
solutions.ur: Agar battery phir bhi fault de rahi hai to kuch bhi badalne se pehle BMS ka apna fault code padhein.

title.en: Inverter does not communicate with meter
title.ur: Inverter meter se communicate nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The inverter and the energy meter are not talking over RS485, so export control is unavailable.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur energy meter RS485 par baat nahi kar rahe, is liye export control available nahi.

causes.en: Meter not powered, or RS485 cable loose
causes.ur: Meter powered nahi, ya RS485 cable loose hai

causes.en: Meter address or baud rate not matching the inverter setting
causes.ur: Meter ka address ya baud rate inverter setting se match nahi karta

solutions.en: Check if the meter is on - look for its own status LED.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter on hai ya nahi - uska apna status LED dekhein.

solutions.en: Check that the inverter-to-meter connection is normal and the RS485 cable is seated at both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter se meter ka connection normal hai aur RS485 cable dono taraf baitha hua hai.

solutions.en: Compare the meter's address and baud rate against the inverter's communication settings.
solutions.ur: Meter ka address aur baud rate inverter ki communication settings se compare karein.

title.ur: EEPROM mein ghalti - memory ka masla (warning 404)

meaning.en: The M3 board reports a memory abnormality as a warning rather than a hard fault.
meaning.ur: M3 board memory abnormality ko hard fault ke bajaye warning ke tor par report karta hai.

causes.en: Marginal EEPROM chip or a bad I2C solder joint
causes.ur: Marginal EEPROM chip ya kharab I2C solder joint

causes.en: Power interruption while writing settings
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power chala jana

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see whether the warning clears.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke dekhein ke warning clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the warning persists, contact Growatt customer service to replace the M3 board.
solutions.ur: Agar warning bacha rahe to Growatt customer service se M3 board badalwane ka request karein.

solutions.en: Before any firmware update, fully power the unit down as Growatt's warranty terms require.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi firmware update karne se pehle unit ko poori tarah power down karein, jaise Growatt ke warranty terms kehti hain.
